t: Autologous Transplant | AdventHealth Medical Group
s: An autologous transplant is a procedure that takes a person’s own stem cells and returns them to the body at a later stage to help replace damaged cells due to high doses of chemotherapy. This procedure is used to treat a variety of blood cancers, including leukemia, lymphoma and myeloma; as well as some solid tumors, such as breast cancer, testicular cancer and osteosarcoma.
